336:t_104:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't think I won't shoot a former teammate! I haven't the slightest intention of forgiving you or that bastard $$バルビエル$$!」

336:t_105:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$揺れる天秤$$! I've been waiting for you!」

336:t_105:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks for the warm welcome. But if I was going to hear such shocking news, I wish I'd never come back.」

336:t_105:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That won't do! His Majesty has been waiting to see you!」

336:t_105:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「So I will not take your life...! At the very least, I will leave you alive!」

336:t_105:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You amaze me. Can you really afford to say that?」

336:t_105:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If you want to enjoy a fight, give it everything you've got! Half measures won't let you take me on!」

336:t_105:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You said it well! You seem to be a warrior worthy of being my rival!」

336:t_105:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No thanks to that title either! I'm fighting strictly for peace, freedom, and paying off my debts!」

336:t_106:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(The Chief and $$エスター$$ are awfully cold. I told them I was coming home. They could at least have come to welcome me...)

336:t_106:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Well... If they'd announced a million G debt with gong and triangle sound effects, even I might not have recovered...!)
